title: YouTube SEO Strategy for Sleep Content

algorithm_2026.overview: YouTube algorithm is multiple recommendation engines across search, suggested, browse, Shorts, and notifications. Search algorithm matters most for sleep content.

key_factors.title: Primary keyword in first 30 characters. 50-60 chars total to avoid truncation on mobile.
key_factors.thumbnail: 1280x720. High contrast, bold text, clear focal point. Single biggest lever on CTR.
key_factors.tags: 8-15 relevant tags. Secondary signal, not primary. Help algorithm categorize.
key_factors.captions: YouTube indexes transcript text. Review auto-generated captions for accuracy.
key_factors.chapters: Descriptive timestamps give algorithm additional keyword context.
key_factors.ctr: Healthy CTR is 4-9%. Below 2% means thumbnail/title needs rework.

sleep_specific.watch_time: Sleep videos have extreme watch time (3-10 hours). This is the #1 signal.
sleep_specific.completion_rate: Low percentage but high absolute hours. 30% of 10 hours = 3 hours average.
sleep_specific.repeat_views: Sleep viewers return to same video nightly. Massive repeat view signal.
sleep_specific.black_screen: Reduces production cost, improves sleep quality, proven format.

examples: Rain Sounds for Sleeping — 8 Hours of Gentle Rain
History to Sleep To — The Entire Story of Ancient Egypt
Video Game Lore to Fall Asleep To — Elder Scrolls
Buddhism to Sleep To — The Dhammapada Explained
rules: Front-load primary keyword in first 30 characters
Keep under 60 characters to avoid truncation
Use 'to sleep to' or 'to fall asleep to' as suffix
Avoid 'NO ADS' in title (save for description)
Use power words: Gentle, Calm, Relaxing, Deep

structure: Line 6-10: Benefits (helps you sleep, relax, study)

design_rules: High contrast (dark background for sleep content)
Clear focal point (single image or symbol)
Color palette per shelf (gold for spiritual, blue for mind, etc.)

title_thumbnail_combo.rule: Title and thumbnail complement, not repeat

example.title: Rain Sounds for Sleeping — 8 Hours
example.thumbnail: Dark rain on window, soft blue tones, '8H' badge

strategies: Hook in first 30 seconds (state what they'll get)
No cliffhangers (sleep content must be drop-safe)
sleep_specific: Longer videos = more watch time per view

upload_strategy.frequency: 2-3 videos per week for growth, 1 per week for maintenance
playlist_strategy: Create playlist per series (e.g., 'Grimm's Fairy Tales — Complete')
Add new videos to relevant playlists

medium_volume: video game lore to sleep to
long_tail: rain sounds in a tent for sleeping
elder scrolls lore to fall asleep to
ancient egypt history for deep sleep

freshness_strategy.insight: Sleep content thrives on repetition, not freshness. Same video watched nightly.
freshness_strategy.implication: Don't chase trending topics. Build catalog that compounds.
freshness_strategy.upload_schedule: Consistent, not frequent. 1/week is enough if quality is high.
freshness_strategy.catalog_growth: Each new video adds to the library. Library compounds over time.

common_mistakes: Generic title (e.g., 'Sleep Video 23' instead of descriptive)
Ignoring Shorts (200B daily views, great for discovery)
Not adding to playlists (misses session watch time)
